$comment: Screenshots for EconByte 1.1, captured from the release-configuration binary by EconByteUITests/ScreenshotTests. No mockups, no device frames, no compositing - these are raw XCUIScreen captures. Not uploaded: Task 6a makes no App Store Connect call.

capture.device: iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (VR-AppStore-6.9), iOS 26.5, build 23F77
capture.configuration: Release, with ENABLE_TESTABILITY=YES passed on the command line only because xcodebuild builds the whole scheme's test action and the unit-test target needs @testable; it changes no UI and no shipped code
capture.method: xcodebuild test -configuration Release -only-testing:EconByteUITests/ScreenshotTests, attachments exported with xcresulttool

storefrontRecommendation.reason: 05 is a true capture, but the frame is dominated by the one-time analytics/diagnostics consent offer that appears after a reader's first completed set. It is excellent privacy evidence and a defensible storefront image if the Owner wants to lead with privacy; it is a weak lead image for a learning app. Recorded rather than silently dropped.

sizesNotProducedLocally: iPhone 6.5" (1242x2688 / 1284x2778): no 6.5" simulator device is installed and the host disk floor did not allow adding one. ASC scales the 6.9" set for smaller iPhone classes; Task 6b confirms against the sizes ASC actually demands.
iPad: not applicable, the app is iPhone-only.

screenshots.screen: Home on a fresh install: TODAY'S CARDS with the eight-card set and Start, the streak row, and the top of BROWSE TOPICS showing Inflation and Interest Rates unlocked.

BROWSE TOPICS scrolled to the new 1.1 topics - Exchange Rates, Consumer Spending, Taxes, Fiscal Policy and Economic Indicators - each showing the lock and 'Unlock to view', with the Bookmarks row beneath.
Card front, Inflation card 1 of 8 ('What Inflation Measures'), with the topic chip, the bookmark control, the educational-use disclaimer and 'Tap to see example'.
Card back for the same card: the real-world grocery-cart example and its source line (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, CPIAUCSL), with the bookmark now filled.
Session complete after finishing the eight-card set: streak 1 day, and the one-time consent offer with both toggles off by default.
Home after completing a set: TODAY'S CARDS shows Done, the progress bar is full and the streak reads 1 day.
Bookmarks with the saved Inflation card, plus the Review Saved action.
